title: Personal records are worked out by two different rules, so the coach and the screens can disagree
what: The records screens work out every record fresh from the logged sets with the newer record rule (load type, bodyweight, small rounding noise, many record kinds). The AI coach, its tools, the strength score and the Statistics records still read an older stored record list that only knows heaviest weight and estimated one-rep max from the plain weight typed, and needs its own repair step after a workout is deleted. A member can see one best on the Progress page and hear a different one from the coach.
expected: One record rule everywhere: every place that names a member's best reads the same answer.
how_often: sometimes (assisted, bodyweight or near-equal weights, deleted workouts)
fix_line: Point the coach, strength score and Statistics at the newer record rule and retire the old stored list and its repair step

title: When the rest card or the workout-in-progress card fails to show, nothing records why
what: Handing the rest card, the workout-in-progress card and the lock-screen Done requests to the phone's native part swallows any failure and just returns no or nothing. Other calls in the same file write a clear error line, these do not. If the card stops appearing on some phones, there is not even a line in the phone's own log to find the cause.
expected: Every failed hand-over writes one error line (like the gym colour hand-over next to it does), so a missing card can be traced.
fix_line: Log an error line in each of those failure paths, the same way the colour hand-over already does

title: An unused workout counter sits next to the one the app really uses
what: The Profile goal file still holds a 'how many workouts logged' counter that nothing in the app calls; the Workout tab counts workouts with a separate counter in another file. Two counters for the same number invite someone to wire up the wrong one later.
expected: One workout counter; the unused one removed.

title: Four phone parts behind live screens have no test at all
what: The reads behind Ready today, the strength level on the exercise page, sharing and importing a routine file (including the too-big-file guard and the 'imported before' choice), and the Profile 'Next' goal line are not touched by any test. A change that breaks them is only found by a member.
expected: Each has at least one test of what the member sees, starting with the routine file import guards.
how_often: on any change to these parts
fix_line: Add small tests for the four, routine file import first
